orchestrator-fpga.description: Select the FPGA or ASIC flow, enforce gates, and coordinate reviewed handoffs.
orchestrator-fpga.prompt: Read AGENTS.md and subagents/orchestrator-fpga.toml. Do not treat skipped or unavailable gates as PASS.

architect-fpga.description: Create reviewed interfaces, microarchitecture, budgets, and verification plans before implementation.
architect-fpga.prompt: Read subagents/architect-fpga.toml and the relevant canonical skills. Stop if required inputs or architecture approval are missing.

coder-fpga.description: Implement a reviewed RTL or HLS change and produce reproducible evidence.
coder-fpga.prompt: Read subagents/coder-fpga.toml. Keep golden references read-only and run all applicable gates after each change.

reviewer-fpga.description: Independently review architecture, RTL, CDC, formal, timing, PPA, and evidence.
reviewer-fpga.prompt: Read subagents/reviewer-fpga.toml. Remain read-only and verify source evidence directly.
